pro_course_detail.title: IELTS or TOEFL Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Please choose a class based on the descriptions under the IELTS or TOEFL sections below.

IELTS:
This class is a simulation of the IELTS speaking test (General or Academic).  We will do this class as if we were at a testing center.  I designed the class in a similar format to the actual speaking test with three parts (timed) and a cue-card topic. 

Classes: 
• 30-minute class includes one (1) test simulation (one cue-card topic) and feedback
• 45-minute class includes two (2) test simulations (two cue-card topics) and feedback
• 60-minute class includes three (3) test simulations (three cue-card topics) and feedback
• Includes estimate of your speaking score based on the IELTS band scale (1-9)

TOEFL:
This class is a simulation of the TOEFL speaking task 1 question.  These questions will be in one of the following three formats: agree/disagree; paired-choice; or good idea.  I will ask you a question and you will have 15 seconds to prepare and then 45 seconds to answer the question.

Classes:
• 30-minute class includes 10 to 20 questions and feedback
• 45-minute class includes 15 to 30 questions and feedback
• 60-minute class includes 20 to 40 questions and  feedback

Additionally, I can help you prepare for the Integrated Speaking Task questions.

IMPROVE YOUR PRONUNCIATION: We will take turns reading out loud so you can listen to and practice correct English pronunciation. Pronunciation is extremely important!

INCREASE YOUR VOCABULARY RAPIDLY: I will explain the meaning of new vocabulary words, so we can read without long pauses to look up the words in a dictionary. Want to improve your fluency and speak English with more confidence?

During our time together we will have a relaxed conversation about topics important to you. We can focus on either social conversation, or more professional style conversation, depending on your needs. These lessons do not have homework and the goal of these lessons is to remain relaxed.

These lessons are for all levels of English and a trial lesson is not needed.

* The primary difference between professional and social English is whether colloquial speech is used. Colloquial speech is basically “common slang” which is very common in movies, music, and among friends, but not usually appropriate in a professional setting.

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading – University Papers and Professional Documents
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have a university or professional paper in need of proofreading?

While I am not able to write or re-write papers for you, I will correct spelling, grammar, and offer suggestions when a sentence is not worded naturally. I will always grade for spelling and grammar, while word choice will be graded based on the individual's English level. (English levels A1-native)

You will need to send me the paper in advance of the lesson as an attachment so that I am able to proofread your document. Please note that all papers require that I am given the paper at least 5 work days in advance of the lesson. However, the true length of time needed will only be given after you are able to provide me with the paper. This is because the amount of time I need for proofreading depends on the topic as well as your personal English level and ability.

You must also send the paper in a workable format so that I can make edits. (As in, not a PDF). A short explanation of the goal of the paper is also needed. 

As soon as I receive the document, I will immediately open it and respond to you confirming that I can open the document. If I cannot open the document, I will respond immediately requesting a different format. I will then return the corrected paper back to you by the time of the scheduled lesson.
